question: All gold ever mined, about 216,000 tonnes, at 19.3 tonnes per cubic metre: how wide a cube would it make, in metres?
answer: About 22.4 metres a side: every bar, coin and ring ever made, in a cube about seven storeys high.
move: A cube root shrinks a huge volume to a modest length; picture the side.
ask: Which enormous total would look small if I pictured it as one block?
trap: Kilometres wide, because 216,000 tonnes sounds enormous.
hint: Turn tonnes into cubic metres, then find the cube root.
steps: The side is the cube root: 22³ = 10,648 and 23³ = 12,167.
About 22.4 metres a side, roughly a seven-storey block.
source: World Gold Council, how much gold has been mined
